metadata.title: Ethereal Pop Portrait with Serif Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist portrait composition featuring a subject in a textured shaggy coat against a flat pastel background with left-aligned, high-contrast serif display text.
excludeWhen: busy or cluttered backgrounds are required
sans-serif or modern geometric typography is requested
high-saturation neon color palettes are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a blonde woman with eyes closed and hair blowing across her face, wearing a voluminous brown shaggy fur coat open at the front, set against a solid light cyan background with three lines of gold-toned serif text in the upper left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned on the right third of the frame
Text block anchored in the upper left negative space
High texture contrast between the shaggy fur and smooth background
Color harmony between the golden-brown fur and the gold-toned typography
coreInvariants: Subject's hair obscuring facial features to create an ethereal mood
Left-aligned, all-caps serif typography with consistent leading

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the waist.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the wind-swept hair act as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the text in the upper left, move across the hair to the subject's face, and down the texture of the coat.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space on the left side provides room for the typographic elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm brown and tan tones of the fur coat
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a soft, matte finish and high-key lighting.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for all lines to maintain minimalist elegance.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and sharp serifs of the display text.
Provides the classical Roman skeleton and elegant proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a blonde woman with eyes closed and hair blowing in the wind, wearing a shaggy brown faux-fur coat, against a solid light blue background. Leave the left third of the image as empty space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of left-aligned, all-caps serif text in a muted gold color in the upper left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid pastel color?
Does the subject have wind-swept hair?
Is the font a high-contrast serif?

mustRedesign: Any logos or specific brand names
Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is not touching the subject
Verify the serif font has sharp terminals
Check that the fur texture looks soft and voluminous
Confirm the color palette remains desaturated and pastel
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in textured garment + solid pastel background + left-aligned serif display text = Ethereal Pop Aesthetic
